fields.FIR_Description: According to the complaint registered on 2025-09-14, the complainant was allegedly surrounded and attacked by several persons near Nallur Nagar Main Street after a dispute over a payment settlement. The incident is stated to have occurred on 2025-09-12 at roughly 18:25. The complainant, Gayathri Raman, provided the contact number 9000000100. The complainant alleged that Abirami Raj may be involved and provided the mobile number 9000000141. The complaint refers to Siva Muthu, a relative of the suspect, reachable on 9000000256. A green car with registration KL-07-ZZ-1011 was observed near Nallur Nagar Main Street. The complainant mentioned physical documents.
fields.Modus_Operandi: Group allegedly confronted the victim following an earlier dispute.
fields.Keywords: group assault, injury, suspect, mobile number, car, associate, evening, main street
